definition: Key Performance Indicator — a measurable value that tracks progress toward a business objective.
extendedDefinition: KPIs translate abstract goals like "improve customer satisfaction" into concrete, trackable metrics. Common SaaS KPIs include monthly recurring revenue (MRR), customer acquisition cost (CAC), and net promoter score (NPS). Teams use dashboards to monitor KPIs in real time and make data-driven decisions. Choosing the right KPIs ensures everyone is aligned on what success looks like. Buyers should define the metrics a tool must move before purchase, then review them quarterly after launch to confirm the promised value materializes. Leading indicators like activation and usage often predict retention better than trailing revenue numbers. Review cadence matters as well: monthly tracking catches drift early, while annual reviews arrive too late to steer spending and staffing decisions.
description: A Key Performance Indicator (KPI) is a measurable value that tracks progress toward business objectives. Learn how to define and use KPIs effectively.
